title: Tradescantia Pallidia - 2x Mini Plug Plants - Vibrant Purple Foliage
description:
Stunning Purple Heart Plant for Indoors or Outdoors


KEY FEATURES
• Vibrant, deep purple foliage for year-round colour
• Easy to grow and low maintenance
• Versatile for hanging baskets, ground cover, or houseplants
• Drought-tolerant once established
• Fast-growing with a beautiful trailing habit


PLANT DETAILS
Type: Houseplants — Tradescantia pallida 'Purpurea'
Colour: Purple foliage, pink/pale purple flowers
Season: Summer (flowers), year-round (foliage)
Growth Habit: Trailing, spreading


GROWING CONDITIONS
Sun: Full sun to partial shade
Soil: Moist, well-drained loam or sand, rich in organic matter
Watering: Allow top inch of soil to dry between waterings; drought tolerant
Spacing: 30-90 cm (12 inches - 3 feet)
Height: 15-30 cm (6-12 inches) at crown
Spread: 30-60 cm (1-2 feet) trailing
Hardiness: USDA Zones 10-11 (annual or houseplant elsewhere)


CARE INSTRUCTIONS
• Plant in a location with full sun for the best purple colour, though it tolerates partial shade.
• Water thoroughly when the top inch of soil is dry, then allow to dry out again before rewatering.
• Pinch back stems regularly to encourage bushier growth and maintain shape.
• Bring indoors before temperatures drop below 10°C (50°F) if growing as a perennial in cooler climates.
• Easily propagated from stem cuttings to refresh plants or create new ones.


WHAT'S INCLUDED
2x Mini Plug Plants
